item.bookofe.worm_hammer.ability.desc: Burrow forward and slam the ground.
item.bookofe.moon_sword.ability.desc: Sneak + Right-click: Beam damages and blinds. 12s cooldown.
item.bookofe.beach_blade.ability.desc: Dash forward dealing bonus damage. Extinguishes fire/lava. 10s cooldown.
item.bookofe.the_black_blade.passive.des: Chance to deal true damage and inflict wither.
item.bookofe.the_black_blade.ability.des: Dark energy wave damages enemies in a cone. 10s cooldown.

item.bookofe.calamityblade.ability.desc: Cleave nearby enemy, dealing massive damage. 4s cooldown.
item.bookofe.slime_hammer.ability.desc: Spawn 2-3 slime buddies for 5 seconds. 12s cooldown.

advancement.bookofe.discover_shrine.desc: Discover a mysterious shrine hidden in the wilderness
advancement.bookofe.root.title: Book of E

advancement.bookofe.kill_joe_rebel.title: Rebel's End
ritual.bookofe.chaos_summoner: The void trembles... Chaos answers the call.
ritual.bookofe.crimson_knight: The crimson seal awakens... Valor rises from the altar.
ritual.bookofe.golden_king: A divine light descends... The golden king stirs.
ritual.bookofe.shadow_rebel: Darkness coalesces... The shadow rebel emerges.
ritual.bookofe.fallen_shadow: The obsidian weeps... The fallen shadow awakens.
ritual.bookofe.slime_king: The goo pulses with life... The slime king materializes.
jei.bookofe.summon_key_nicky.desc: Used to summon Nicky, Sassy Summoner at a Cult Altar. Requires discovering a shrine first.
jei.bookofe.summon_key_eli.desc: Used to summon King Hajile at a Cult Altar. Requires discovering a shrine first.
jei.bookofe.summon_key_milly.desc: Used to summon Milly, Knight Commander at a Cult Altar. Requires discovering a shrine first.
jei.bookofe.summon_key_joe.desc: Used to summon Joe, Rebel Leader at a Cult Altar. Requires discovering a shrine first.
jei.bookofe.cult_altar.desc: A mystical altar used to summon powerful bosses. Place a summoning key on the altar to begin the ritual.
jei.bookofe.worm_hammer.desc: A powerful hammer that triggers shockwaves. Every 3rd hit causes Tremor Hit. Right-click to use Burrow Slam ability.
jei.bookofe.slime_hammer.desc: A gooey hammer with defensive properties. 20% chance to absorb damage. Right-click to spawn slime allies.
jei.bookofe.moon_sword.desc: A blade that grows stronger under moonlight. +20% damage at night. Right-click while sneaking to use Moonfall ability.
jei.bookofe.beach_blade.desc: A watery blade that allows you to dash forward like a riptide. Right-click to use Riptide Crash, dashing 6-8 blocks and dealing bonus damage to the first enemy hit. Extinguishes fire and lava, and applies Soaked effect.
jei.bookofe.blackborn.desc: A cursed blade with a chance to deal true damage and inflict wither on hit. Right-click to use Void Slash ability.
jei.bookofe.calamity.desc: A devastating blade that applies Rend (bleed) on hit. Right-click to use Cleave ability, which triggers all stored bleed damage.
